text: Slashing establishes a Nash equilibrium in which rational validators adhere to honest behavior, because the expected cost of penalties exceeds any short-term gain available from misconduct.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5225296

isBasedOn.name: Cryptographic Foundations and Interdisciplinary Dimensions of the Secure Proof of Stake (SPoS) Conse

abstract: game-theoretic models, which demonstrate that slashing establishes a Nash equilibrium wherein rational validators are incentivized to adhere to honest behavior, as the expected cost of penalties outweighs any potential short-term gains from misconduct
